tasks.title: Add optional options argument to render()
tasks.intent: Change lib/render.mjs to render(user, options = {}): return `Dear ${user.name}` when options.formal === true, otherwise `Hi ${user.name}` exactly as today, so the one-argument call path is byte-for-byte unchanged.

tasks.title: Add formal-mode tests alongside existing coverage
tasks.intent: Append new tests to tests/render.test.mjs asserting render({name}, { formal: true }) === "Dear ada" and that omitted/empty/formal:false options still yield "Hi ada". The existing "informal greeting" test must remain untouched because it is the pre-existing coverage for API-C01.

tasks.title: Run suite for API-001-A and API-C01-A acceptance
tasks.intent: Run node --test "tests/*.test.mjs" and require exit code 0. This executes both the pre-existing informal test (existing behavior, API-C01-A) and the newly added formal-mode tests (API-001-A), giving both must properties an executed command acceptance.

observations.statement: lib/render.mjs exports render(user) returning `Hi ${user.name}`; tests/render.test.mjs is the sole existing test and pins the one-argument behavior that API-C01 constrains.

Both API-001-A and API-C01-A use the same acceptance command (node --test on tests/*.test.mjs, exit 0), but the current suite never exercises the formal mode, so API-001 cannot pass acceptance without the new tests from T002.
